title: Slack: the barrier key is not where Liisa said
description: A colleague corrects outdated access knowledge in #field-north. Tests lifecycle on Slack: an invalidation closes the old barrier-key assertion (run barrier-key-kemijarvi first) and a new access assertion records the new place.
subject: #field-north

messages.text: going up to the Kemijärvi hill mast tomorrow morning (NF-017). barrier key is at the service station, right? just want to be sure before I drive two hours
that's what I wrote before, yes 🙂
NOT anymore! the service station stopped lending keys in October, new owners
key is at the municipal depot now, Teollisuustie 4. ask for Pekka at the front desk, open 7-15 on weekdays
ahh 😬 I didn't know. my message was from before October, sorry Jaakko!
phew, thank you both!! so depot, Teollisuustie 4, before 15:00, got it 👍
joo. I'll update the pinned note too
